title: Nucleic Acid Extraction Using 1.5mL Tubes
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Add Buffer 1 to tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL of Buffer 1 into each 1.5 mL tube that will be placed on the temperature module.

steps.title: Transfer samples into Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Pipette 500 µL of each sample from the 1.5 mL tubes in the Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack into the corresponding tubes containing Buffer 1.

steps.title: Add DNA, beads, heat, then transfer
steps.instruction: After the required heating step, add the DNA reagent and magnetic beads to each tube on the temperature module, then move the entire tube contents to a deep‑well plate positioned on the magnetic module.

substeps.instruction: Perform the heating step as specified in the OT‑2 protocol (temperature and time not detailed in the source).
Add the DNA reagent to each tube.
Add magnetic beads to each tube.
Transfer the tubes (or their contents) to a deep‑well plate on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module; once the beads have settled, aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Perform three Buffer 2 washes
steps.instruction: Using Buffer 2, carry out three consecutive wash steps on the magnetic module, each followed by bead settlement and supernatant removal.

steps.title: Add Buffer 3, mix, incubate
steps.instruction: Replace the tube(s) in the tube rack with Buffer 3 and the Reaction Mix, add Buffer 3 to the beads, mix thoroughly, return the mixture to the temperature module, and incubate for 5 minutes at 65 °C.

substeps.instruction: Prompt the user to replace the tube(s) in the tube rack with Buffer 3 and the Reaction Mix.
Add Buffer 3 to the bead suspension.
Mix the beads with Buffer 3 to ensure homogeneity.
Transfer the mixture back to the temperature module.

steps.title: Transfer to fresh wells and engage magnet
steps.instruction: After incubation, move the samples to new, clean wells of the deep‑well plate on the magnetic module, then engage the magnet once all transfers are complete.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each sample to a fresh well in the deep‑well plate on the magnetic module.
Engage the magnetic module after all samples have been placed.

steps.title: Distribute reaction mix to PCR strips
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared reaction mix into all designated PCR strip wells.

steps.title: Transfer elution and add to reaction mix
steps.instruction: Move the eluted nucleic acid to a clean PCR strip, then transfer 5 µL of this elution into two tubes that already contain the reaction mix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire elution to a clean PCR strip.
Pipette 5 µL of the elution into each of the two tubes containing the reaction mix.

steps.title: Final 65°C 20‑minute incubation
steps.instruction: Prompt the user to place the samples at 65 °C for a final 20‑minute incubation to complete the protocol.
